Cross Country

  • You must have an accumulative high school G.P.A. of 3.5 or better to be eligible. Grades must be computed on a 4.000 unweighted scale and carried out to 3 decimal places. If your school does not use a 4.0 scale, you must have your guidance counselor convert the average to a 4.0 unweighted scale equivalent.
  • Athletes must qualify for or compete in the State Cross Country Meet as an individual or a team member.
  • Freshmen are not eligible.

Track & Field

  • You must have an accumulative high school G.P.A. of 3.5 or better to be eligible. Grades must be computed on a 4.000 unweighted scale and carried out to 3 decimal places. If your school does not use a 4.0 scale you must have your guidance counselor convert the average to a 4.0 unweighted scale equivalent.
  • Athletes must qualify for or participate in the State Track Meet as an individual or relay team member.
  • Freshmen and relay team alternates are not eligible.
